title: DECISION: SceneAsset update of extension props
description: Needs Mark's ruling (from JMAP-0x0q.68 item 5). draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 at 33702a5 L698: 'update supports patching name, assetUri, and sha256. All other properties are immutable or server-set.' L844 Update Errors: invalidProperties for 'Attempting to change a property other than name, assetUri, or sha256', description column naming id, accountId, ownerId, blobId, mediaType, size, createdAt. crate-jmap-scene-server/src/asset.rs update_asset rejects only those seven (IMMUTABLE) and lets vendor extension properties through; SceneRegion/SceneObject/SceneAvatar updates use the same deny-list shape. Options: (A) keep: read 'all other properties' as the spec-defined ones, consistent with sibling handlers and the AGENTS.md extras-preservation policy; record the decision in asset.rs docs. (B) literal: reject every key outside name/assetUri/sha256 with invalidProperties (allow-list), and decide whether siblings follow. Recommendation: A, plus a scene spec bead asking the draft to say whether extension properties are patchable.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: amend the draft (done: jmap-chat-spec 9e1bedb, new scene-00 section 'Extension Properties in Updates' {#scene-extension-properties}: servers MAY accept patches to vendor extension properties, MUST NOT to spec-defined immutable/server-set ones; SceneAsset update text and invalidProperties row updated). Code already does this (asset.rs:454-461); remaining work: cite the new section in asset.rs and the other Scene handlers' docs, then close.
